display_title: Welcome to the Lonely Editorial Board
description:
Ji-Hoo and Eugene reunite as PD and writer at a webtoon contest awards ceremony. The two, who were college classmates, did assignments together and even kissed… but Ji-Hoo avoids Eugene’s calls and treats him only as a writer even after becoming his PD. One day, when sharing the storyboard is delayed, Eugene complains about the pain of creation(?) due to his inexperience in dating and proposes a contract relationship to Ji-Hoo…

*“I won’t let you go this time.”*

Will Ji-Hoo and Eugene be able to finish their work safely?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)
